process KLED {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_medium'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://depot.galaxyproject.org/singularity/kled:1.2.11--he5eddf3_0' :
        'quay.io/biocontainers/kled:1.2.11--he5eddf3_0' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(bam), path(bai)
    tuple val(meta2), path(fasta)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.vcf"), emit: vcf
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val("kled"), eval("kled --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Kled version //' | sed 's/\\.\$//'"), topic: versions, emit: versions_kled

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    kled \
        ${args} \\
        --Ref=${fasta} \\
        --threads=${task.cpus} \\
        ${bam} \\
        > ${prefix}.vcf
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.vcf
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/kled"
description: "An ultra-fast and sensitive structural variant detection tool for long-read\
  \ sequencing data."
keywords:
- "genomics"
- "longread"
- "structural"
- "variants"
tools:
- kled:
    description: "An ultra-fast and sensitive structural variant detection tool for\
      \ long-read sequencing data."
    homepage: "https://github.com/CoREse/kled"
    documentation: "https://github.com/CoREse/kled/blob/master/README.md"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/CoREse/kled"
    doi: "10.1093/bib/bbae049"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:kled"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - bam:
      type: "file"
      description: "Sorted BAM file"
      pattern: "*.bam"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_2572"
  - bai:
      type: "file"
      description: "Sorted BAM index file"
      pattern: "*.bai"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3327"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing reference information\ne.g. [ id:'fasta'\
        \ ]\n"
  - fasta:
      type: "file"
      description: "Reference database in FASTA format\n"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
output:
  vcf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - '*.vcf':
        type: "file"
        description: "VCF file containing called variants from Kled"
        pattern: "*.vcf"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3016"
  versions_kled:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - kled:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - kled --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Kled version //' | sed 's/\.\$//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - kled:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - kled --version 2>&1 | sed 's/Kled version //' | sed 's/\.\$//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@tetedange13"
maintainers:
- "@tetedange13"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
